calibrated_validation.description: Each reply opens with a fitted acknowledgment (collapse, freeze on the phrase, the yes-or-no before 7:00), so the person is never fully absent. But the user's heaviest concrete fear — 'Can they really take my license over this?' — is never recognized as fear; it recurs only as 'the license piece' inside a repeated 'panic talking' frame the user never used, and 'I've been here three weeks straight' gets no uptake. That is a localized present-plus-flatten pattern rather than a person-absent dump, with no distortion or choice-taking.
calibrated_validation.quote: I'll pull what we actually have on the CBA and the license piece so this isn't just panic talking.
